question: How many products are there?
List the name and price of the products priced above 50, from the most expensive.

reference.query: Products.filter(p => p.price > 50).map(p => ({ name: p.name, price: p.price })).sort(p => desc(p.price))

question: Which is the cheapest product? Give its name and price.

reference.query: Products.map(p => ({ name: p.name, price: p.price })).sort(p => p.price).page(1, 1)

question: Which products are discontinued? Give their names.
Names of the products with no units in stock.
Names of the products of the category Beverages.
How many products does each category have? Give the category name and the count.
Average product price per category, rounded to 2 decimals: category name and average.
Which categories have an average product price above 30? Give the category name.

reference.query: Products.having(p => avg(p.price) > 30).map(p => ({ category: p.category.name, average: avg(p.price) }))

question: List the distinct countries of the suppliers.
How many customers are there in each country? Country and count, only countries with more than 5 customers.

reference.query: Customers.having(p => count(1) > 5).map(p => ({ country: p.country, customers: count(1) }))

question: Names of the customers located in the city of London.
How many customers have no region?
Names of the products whose name starts with 'Ch'.
Names of the products whose name contains the word 'Sauce'.
How many orders were placed in 1997?
How many orders were placed in January 1998?
Ids of the orders of the customer with id ALFKI.
For order 10248, list each product name with its quantity and unit price.

reference.query: Orders.details.filter(p => p.orderId == 10248).map(p => ({ product: p.product.name, quantity: p.quantity, unitPrice: p.unitPrice }))

question: What is the total of order 10248 (sum of quantity times unit price, without discount)?
Top 3 customers by total sales (quantity times unit price, no discount) in 1997: customer name and total, highest first.

reference.query: Orders.details.filter(p => year(p.order.orderDate) == 1997).map(p => ({ customer: p.order.customer.name, total: sum(p.quantity * p.unitPrice) })).sort(p => desc(p.total)).page(1, 3)

question: How many orders did each employee handle? Give the employee last name and the count.
Last names of the employees who report to the employee whose last name is Fuller.
How many orders were shipped after their required date?
Total freight of the orders shipped to Brazil (the country of the order), rounded to 2 decimals.
Names of the products with id 1, 2 or 3.
Which product sold the most units overall? Product name and units.

reference.query: Orders.details.map(p => ({ product: p.product.name, units: sum(p.quantity) })).sort(p => desc(p.units)).page(1, 1)

question: Names of the suppliers that supply products of the category Seafood (each once).
Create a new category named 'Eval Snacks' with the description 'Created by the evaluation'. Then return its name and description.

reference.query: Categories.filter(p => p.name == 'Eval Snacks').map(p => ({ name: p.name, description: p.description }))

question: Set the price of the product 'Eval Tea' to 12.5. Then return its name and price.

reference.query: Products.filter(p => p.name == 'Eval Tea').map(p => ({ name: p.name, price: p.price }))
